title: 急

sentences.imageNotes: 家庭或學校走廊場景，主角小女孩遇到需要協助的急事，開口叫附近可信任的人幫忙。可畫主角小女孩指向掉落或打翻的物品，旁邊有老師或主角媽媽準備協助。人物身份要明確：主角小女孩、老師或主角媽媽。不可有文字、數字或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L245-S01 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. In a warm school hallway, the protagonist little girl has an urgent problem: a small box of safe classroom materials has tipped over and scattered soft paper shapes and blocks. She points to the mess and calls for help. A trusted teacher is stepping closer to help, calm and reassuring. The scene clearly communicates: when there is an urgent matter, call someone to help.
Visual cast: protagonist little girl follows L154/L162/L163 family continuity, with pink hair clip and child proportions. Teacher is a separate adult teacher identity, tidy classroom clothing and calm instructional posture, visually distinct from the protagonist mother and not using the mother's yellow or coral-red family palette. L058 images are illustration style anchors only; do not copy any L058 person.
Composition: center the little girl's pointing gesture, the spilled safe materials, and the teacher arriving to help; keep all meaning-bearing objects inside safe margins for a square crop.
Style/medium: approved L058 style traits: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environment, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette, phone-readable square composition.
Constraints: no written text, numbers, signs, labels, tags, logos, brands, zhuyin, watermarks, readable marks, or emergency signage.

sentences.text: 車子要開走了，我很著急。
sentences.spokenText: 車子要開走了我很著急
sentences.imageNotes: 車站或路邊安全場景，一輛車準備開走，主角小女孩和主角媽媽站在安全位置，主角小女孩看起來很著急。車子不可有車牌號碼、路線文字、數字、標誌或標籤。人物身份要明確：主角小女孩、主角媽媽。
